summary.text: Angie King is a Republican state representative who has represented Ohio House District 84 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her as a business owner and former Mercer County recorder who served on the Celina City Council.

paragraphs.text: King earned a B.S. in communication and organizational leadership in 2010 and an M.B.A. in 2015, both from Wright State University.
Her career experience includes work as a realtor at Lake Shore Realty, business owner at King Properties and Investments, and Mercer County recorder.
She served on the Celina City Council, volunteered as president of the Deafness Research Foundation and served on the Ohio Board of Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology.
King succeeded Susan Manchester in District 84 and defeated Democrat Arienne Childrey in the November 5, 2024 general election.
She serves on the Government Oversight, Health and Insurance committees and chairs Local Government.
Arienne Childrey is again the Democratic candidate in the 2026 general election.
